t: Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ladaat
s: Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ladaat ubo g' seipim: mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum, sheen lo ella d' ammot, vehutzrak linqabayv — yakol latzet mehen ad sheyyimtza maqom tzanua lippanot, sheggadol kebod habberiyyot. Veetza toba lo sheyyitqareb letzad techumo sheyyatza mimmennu, sheim lo yimtza maqom tzanua ad techumo — yakol liknos, uleachar shenniknas hare hu keillu lo yatza, kevan shenniknas birshut. Abal im matza maqom tzanua qodem — lo yiknos, ella yippaneh sham veyitracheq mimmaqom shennipneh ad sheyyikleh hareach, vesham yesh lo d' ammot. Veim nitracheq mehareach veniknas bitchumo — keillu lo yatza, kevan shenniknas birshut chakamim, shechasu al kebodo velo hitzrikuhu laamod bemaqom metunnap o reach ra. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyatza shello ladaat. Abal im yatza ladaat, ap al pi shenniknas birshut letok techum sheyyatza mimmennu — en lo sham ella d' ammot, ella im ken niknas lair sheshshabat bah, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"h:

Zeh sheamarnu behutzrak linqabayv — yesh omerim apillu liqtannim, veyesh omerim shello heqellu mishshum kebod habberiyyot latzet chutz led' ammot ella bigdolim, abal biqtannim en kebod habberiyyot kol kak, shehare mashtinim mayim bipne rabbim, vegam en lachush sheyyaamod bemaqom metunnap, mippene shebbeme raglayim en kol kak tinnup, shenniblaim bimqomam. (Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem) debatrai ninehu:
Lo behutzrak linqabayv bilbad heqellu ken, ella apillu im geshamim yoredim alayv o shehachamma zorachat alayv umetzaarto, kemo shennitbaer besimman t"d:
